sources.snippet: Arya-3B-MoE (Chanakya Labs) Arya-3B-MoE is a next-generation Native Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Foundation Model engineered by Chanakya Labs. Arya incorporates linear-time sequence mixing, quantile-balanced sparse routing, multi-branch gated residuals, and native multi-token prediction from the ground up.
